$comment: The three crosses lead the three acclamations as the Latin Patriarchate Vicariate's own Hebrew prayerbook prints them — one at each 'Holy', where the hand moves. The short form deliberately has none: the prayerbook does not give it one, and it is not this file's place to even them up. Hebrew only, because the Vicariate's book is what was seen; the other languages keep the plain text until someone has looked at a prayerbook in those. The Mission of St. Gamaliel's rite has its own Trisagion entirely (see he-x-gamliel.json) and is not touched by this.

prayers.trisagionAcclamation: ✠ קָדוֹשׁ הָאֱלֹהִים, ✠ קָדוֹשׁ הַגִּבּוֹר, ✠ קָדוֹשׁ הַנֶּצְחִי, רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ.
